plan.batching: Independent per-context features and batched classifier forward pass; sequential versus batch scores checked on first development recording. Audio timestamps are retained; offline batch traces claim no per-window delivery time.
plan.policy: For each on-hit count 1/2, set threshold to the (floor(.05*Nneg)+1)th largest negative recording activation statistic plus a 1e-5 numerical margin. Select maximal development recall within the 5% negative-file budget, then lower threshold, lower FPR, two hits. Off threshold .75×on, two off hits.
plan.reason: Scores of small CNNs cluster between coarse grid thresholds. Separate a calibration limitation from spectral ranking.
plan.scope: Additional DEVELOPMENT calibration after observing coarse-grid failures. No new final assessment; no neural weights retrained; default unchanged.
plan.warning: Development FPR is constrained by construction, not evidence of generalization. Budget is a provisional engineering choice.
